description: The chart presents three pie charts, each representing the distribution of difficulty levels in knowledge crosswords as processed by a zero-shot model. The first pie chart, labeled "easy," shows four categories: N+K+ (55.4%), N-K+ (38.3%), N-K- (1.7%), and N+K- (4.6%). The second pie chart, labeled "medium," also has four categories: N+K+ (58.8%), N-K+ (35.4%), N-K- (1.8%), and N+K- (4.0%). The third pie chart, labeled "hard," includes four categories: N+K+ (37.3%), N-K+ (18.1%), N-K- (6.7%), and N+K- (37.9%). Each pie chart is color-coded with a legend indicating the categories: N+K+ (green), N-K+ (yellow), N-K- (orange), and N+K- (red). The percentages are displayed within the corresponding slices of each pie chart. The slices are not visually emphasized in any particular way, and there are no percentage labels inside the slices. The slices appear to be ordered by size, with the largest slice in each pie chart being N+K+.
